subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Do the outbound and QQBot owners approve the text/poll capability gates and reconnect backoff-bypass selector as the canonical behavior for delivery resolution and recovery?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish the reported fix, but only owners can confirm compatibility with supported external plugin adapter shapes and the intended retry semantics for queued QQBot messages.

options.title: Owner-confirm and land
options.body: Approve the exact capability gates and QQBot selector, then merge once the exact-head branch and required checks remain green.

options.title: Narrow the recovery selector
options.body: Keep the resolver fix but restrict bypassBackoff to specifically classified reconnect errors if broad error-text matching is not intended.

options.title: Pause for adapter compatibility
options.body: Hold the PR until owners identify and test any supported external outbound shape not represented by sendText, message.send.text, gateway mode, or sendPoll.

recommendation.title: Owner-confirm and land
recommendation.body: Approve the exact capability gates and QQBot selector, then merge once the exact-head branch and required checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person to both the outbound resolution implementation and QQBot lifecycle callbacks changed by the PR.
